title: Benchmark: GET /v1/meta/build-info
goal: Add a public, unauthenticated GET /v1/meta/build-info endpoint to caffeine-api that returns {sha, built_at, service} from the build environment, documented in the OpenAPI spec.
dod: GET /v1/meta/build-info answers 200 with JSON {sha, built_at, service} and no auth
the route has a unit test in caffeine-api and appears in the generated OpenAPI spec
curl against the PR's factory preview API returns the preview's deployed sha
constraints: No new dependencies. Follow the module layout of services/caffeine-api/src/modules.
demo_focus: curl the endpoint on the preview and show the JSON body next to the deployed sha
